subject: Aligning Marketplace Metering with Partner-Led Trials & Entitlements
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <ps@cloudbridge.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace metering + partner trial flows (request)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the great demo last week. As CloudBridge works to list our joint solution on AWS/GCP marketplaces we hit two integration gaps that we hoped Redwood could help align on:

1) Partner-led trials: our sellers want to provision short trials from CloudBridge that spin up a metered sandbox on Redwood-backed infra. We need a clean entitlement mapping so customers in the marketplace trial map to the partner trial SKU (no double-charging).

2) Usage attribution / evidence: marketplace ops requires a simple CSV evidence export and a mapping file so they can reconcile meter reports during onboarding.

I've attached a first-pass entitlement_matrix_v3.xlsx and a short metering_spec_draft.pdf. Can your team confirm Redwood's ability to:
- surface partner trial SKUs via the catalog?
- provide per-trial run CSVs with account mapping and start/end times?
- accept a CloudBridge partner ID that won't create duplicate seats when the customer converts?

If possible could we get a technical + GTM alignment call next week? Suggested participants: Naomi, Ben (pricing/entitlements), Vivek (co-sell ops). 

Best,
Jordan
Partner Success | CloudBridge

Attachment stubs: entitlement_matrix_v3.xlsx (excel), metering_spec_draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com>
To: Jordan Mills <ps@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace metering + partner trial flows (request)

Jordan — really helpful, thanks for the detailed artifacts.

Short answers up front: yes on partner trial SKUs (we can expose partner-affiliated SKUs and a partner_id tag), yes on per-trial CSV evidence exports, and yes we can map partner trials to marketplace listings to avoid duplicate entitlements, but there are a couple of constraints and options to pick between (see below).

Options we should evaluate in the call:
- Option A: Marketplace-native SKU + partner_id attribute. Fastest, but requires marketplace metering policy to accept partner_id column for attribution.
- Option B: Partner-managed trial SKU that routes to a Redwood partner-tenant and then migrates to customer-owned subscription on conversion. Cleaner separation but longer onboarding.

Technical considerations (for Ben & infra):
- Do we need CloudBridge to pass a stable external_partner_id in every request? (recommended)
- CSV export columns: customer_marketplace_account_id, redwood_account_id, trial_start, trial_end, consumed_units, partner_id, sku_id.

I've scheduled a 45-min alignment for next Wed 12/09 10:00 PT — invite attached. If that doesn't work we can shift.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com>, Jordan Mills <ps@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 12:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace metering + partner trial flows (request)

Thanks Naomi. A couple of quick technical notes ahead of the call: 

- Partner_id: we can accept an external_partner_id header or field in provisioning calls; it will get persisted to the entitlement record. Recommend header + request body to make it robust across SDKs.
- Metering export: we can generate daily and ad-hoc CSVs with the exact columns you listed. We'll need CloudBridge to seed the mapping in the entitlement_matrix (attached) so we can validate during the first 3-5 customers.
- Trial lifecycle: if you plan to flip entitlements to a marketplace subscription on conversion, we need a churn-safe handoff path to preserve KV cache and usage history (we've got a migration job pattern for that).

Attaching a short sample export (sample_metering_export.csv) and a migration-runbook excerpt.

-Ben
Senior Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: sample_metering_export.csv, migration_runbook.md

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
To: Jordan Mills <ps@cloudbridge.io>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace metering + partner trial flows (request)

Jordan / Naomi — putting ops context on top:

- AWS/GCP marketplace teams will ask for a clear metering evidence cadence and a reconciliation owner. We (Redwood) can provide daily CSV exports; CloudBridge needs to nominate a reconciler for the first 90 days.
- For co-sell listing entitlements we should pick Option A for initial pilots (less friction) and revisit Option B once we scale.
- I opened a HubSpot task and linked the deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-4782 — please add onboarding owners and the preferred cutover date.

Next operational asks for Jordan/CloudBridge:
1) Finalize the entitlement_matrix_v3.xlsx with CloudBridge partner IDs populated for pilot customers.
2) Sign the metering evidence SLA (short doc, I'll circulate).
3) Confirm which marketplace(s) to pilot first (AWS preferred).

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Field Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Mills <ps@cloudbridge.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace metering + partner trial flows (request)

Thanks all — good to align. Quick updates:
- ACME Analytics (pilot customer) has approved the trial model and provided their procurement info. They'll be our first reconciliation test. I've cc'd their procurement alias: procure@acme-analytics.com.
- I've populated the entitlement_matrix_v3.xlsx with partner IDs for the three pilot accounts and attached the updated file.
- We can pilot on AWS first.

Could you (Naomi/Ben) confirm whether Redwood needs a specific onboarding ticket per customer, or if a single pilot onboarding process (covering all three accounts) is sufficient?

Jordan

Attachment stub: entitlement_matrix_v3.xlsx (updated)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com>
To: Jordan Mills <ps@cloudbridge.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, ACME Analytics - procurement <procure@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace metering + partner trial flows (request)

All — thanks for the updates and the populated matrix. Next steps:

1) Ops: Vivek to create the pilot onboarding ticket and assign recon owner (Vivek: pls confirm by EOD).
2) Tech: Ben to validate the entitlement rows for the three pilot accounts and provide the sample daily CSV by 12/10.
3) Legal/Billing: Laura to review the short metering evidence SLA and confirm acceptance or redlines by 12/11.
4) Sales/GTM: Jordan to inform ACME procurement that Redwood will provide the evidence export and a DocuSign for the pilot agreement.

I'll send the DocuSign link for the pilot SLA once Laura gives the green light. Thanks everyone — excited to get this pilot running.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
